message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The scenario: Defendant He signed a rental agreement with car owner Guo (owner of a taxi). Then He, without Guo's knowledge, pretended to be the car owner, signed a rental agreement with victim Ma, collected rent and deposit totaling 50,600 RMB. Later Guo retrieved the car from Ma. Ma demanded rent and deposit back, He refused. So He defrauded Ma by misrepresenting ownership, obtaining money. This is fraud (诈骗). Also possibly "非法占有为目的" and "虚构事实、隐瞒真相" typical of fraud. Could also be "非法经营租赁" but likely just fraud. The examples: similar to earlier "诈骗" case. So answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>. Possibly also "非法占有" not a crime name. So just 诈骗.

Check if there is also "合同诈骗" (contract fraud). In Chinese criminal law, there is "诈骗罪" (fraud). The description matches. So answer: 诈骗.

Thus final answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>
